variants.headline: Looking back: business-start grant programme ends
variants.sub: Business-starting support under {programme} has come to an end.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The grant programme {programme} for people starting a business had ended.

Our principles require public support to be judged by the purpose it is meant to serve. Neither the launch of a scheme nor its end can settle that question alone. Political responsibility includes attention to who could obtain support, not merely satisfaction that a programme had an appealing description.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The responsibility of {target} should be examined against the programme's recorded payments and refusals. Its conclusion is established, while the merits of individual outcomes require more than the fact of closure alone.

variants.sub: The grant programme {programme} for people starting a business has ended.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to our earlier coverage. Our original account recorded this: The programme {programme} had ended its support for people starting a business.

Our principles require public support to be judged by the purpose it is meant to serve. Neither the launch of a scheme nor its end can settle that question alone. Political responsibility includes attention to who could obtain support, not merely satisfaction that a programme had an appealing description.

Changes since then deserve examination against the original record. The need to distinguish an established event from its associated hopes and fears remains.
